scene_description: A compact multi-zone area centered around player spawn with three distinct landmark zones. A target block at ~6,1,6 (visible from spawn, requiring intentional navigation) points toward a treasure chest at ~12,0,12 containing diamonds, sticks, pink dye, and clear glass. A white terracotta pillar (3-high) at ~-8,0-2,5 marks a northwest zone with a white stained glass wall and birch planks. A magenta terracotta pillar (3-high) at ~10,0-2,-5 marks an eastern zone with acacia planks. A centrally-placed crafting table at ~0,0,5 enables all crafting tasks. Player receives a Silk Touch iron pickaxe for mining glass.
task_text: Find the target block ahead of you, then follow its direction to locate a treasure chest. Collect all items from the chest (diamonds, sticks, pink dye, and glass). Find the white terracotta landmark to the northwest — mine the white stained glass wall nearby and collect birch planks for a birch sign. Find the magenta terracotta landmark to the east and collect acacia planks for a pressure plate. Use the crafting table near spawn to craft: pink stained glass (8 glass + 1 pink dye), a birch sign (6 birch planks + 1 stick), an acacia pressure plate (2 acacia planks), and a diamond axe (3 diamonds + 2 sticks).
design_notes:
SPATIAL LAYOUT:
- Spawn: origin (0,0,0)
- Target block: ~6 ~1 ~6 (~8.5 blocks diagonal from spawn)
- Treasure chest: ~12 ~0 ~12 (northeast, aligned with target direction)
- White terracotta pillar: ~-8 ~0-2 ~5 (northwest, ~9.4 blocks from spawn)
- White stained glass wall: ~-10 to ~-7, y1-3, z7-8 (24 blocks total)
- Birch planks: 8 blocks at floor level (y0) at z6 and z9, x from -9 to -6
- Magenta terracotta pillar: ~10 ~0-2 ~-5 (east-southeast, ~11.2 blocks from spawn)
- Acacia planks: 4 blocks near magenta terracotta (x11-12, z-6 to -7)
- Crafting table: ~0 ~0 ~5 (5 blocks from spawn, central access point)

MATERIAL BUDGET:
- Chest: 3 diamonds (need 3), 4 sticks (need 3), 8 pink dye (need 1), 8 glass (need 8)
- Birch planks: 8 available (need 6) — 2 spare
- Acacia planks: 4 available (need 2) — 2 spare
- White stained glass: 24 available (need 1+ for mining task)

RECIPE VERIFICATION:
- Pink stained glass: 8 glass + 1 pink dye → 8 pink stained glass
- Birch sign: 6 birch planks + 1 stick → 3 birch signs
- Acacia pressure plate: 2 acacia planks → 1 pressure plate
- Diamond axe: 3 diamonds + 2 sticks → 1 diamond axe
